name: tileflow-sdk
description: Public SDK packages and CLI for Tileflow.

scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run verify
scripts.publish:alpha:dry-run: pnpm run check && pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run smoke:capture-public && pnpm -r --filter @tileflow/core --filter @tileflow/static --filter @tileflow/dev --filter @tileflow/capture --filter @tileflow/vite --filter @tileflow/next --filter @tileflow/webpack --filter @tileflow/react --filter @tileflow/vue --filter @tileflow/svelte --filter @tileflow/cli publish --dry-run --force --access public --tag alpha --no-git-checks
